content: EffectComposer pass order convention: RenderPass first (renders scene to a texture, clears buffers), then a chain of ShaderPass instances each reading the previous pass's output texture (tDiffuse) and writing a transformed result, last pass renders to screen (renderToScreen=true or an OutputPass). For a CRT chain: RenderPass -> chromatic aberration ShaderPass (samples RGB channels at offset UVs, must happen on the rendered image before scanlines so channel splitting distorts real geometry edges) -> scanlines ShaderPass (per-pixel darkening using screen-space Y, applied after aberration so lines stay crisp/undistorted) -> vignette ShaderPass (radial darkening from center, applied last so it darkens the whole composited image evenly). Order matters because each pass operates on the previous pass's raster output, not the original scene.
